api.verification_confirmed_meaning: We re-read the signal after the {{verb}} against a source that answered, and it is no longer firing.
api.verification_could_not_check_meaning: The re-check was due and the source did not answer, so this proves nothing either way. A later cycle will retry it by itself.
api.verification_not_checkable_meaning: The {{verb}} was accepted, but this app cannot observe whether it took effect — an acknowledgement leaves an alert firing by design, so the alarm's state says nothing either way.
api.verification_pending_meaning: The {{verb}} returned success, which only means the provider accepted the request. The next heartbeat re-reads the signal to find out whether it took effect.
api.verification_pending_meaning_at: The {{verb}} returned success, which only means the provider accepted the request. The next heartbeat after {{when}} re-reads the signal to find out whether it took effect.
api.verification_still_firing_meaning: The provider accepted the {{verb}} and the signal was still firing when we looked again. The condition this was opened for is live.

manifest.description: An autonomous ops first responder. Watches your alarms, pages, and monitors; claims what fires; investigates it with real context; and proposes a fix — keeping everything it learns in a local ledger so the second occurrence is faster than the first.
manifest.highlight_1: Claims a firing alarm within one heartbeat and investigates before anyone has to look
manifest.highlight_2: Knowledge ledger with confidence and trust levels — a repeat failure resolves from what you already know
manifest.highlight_3: Live board in the dashboard and as replyable Slack threads, so the channel is the dashboard
manifest.highlight_4: Connects AWS CloudWatch, PagerDuty, Datadog, incident.io, GitHub Issues, or any system that can POST signed JSON — including Alertmanager-shaped bodies, fanned out one incident per alert
manifest.highlight_5: Read-only by default — write actions are opt-in per signal pattern, and every one is audited
manifest.highlight_6: Rotation-aware: the on-shift automation tier arms and disarms itself
manifest.use_case_1: Watch operational signals, investigate incidents, reuse proven fixes, and hand over a complete local audit trail.
manifest.configuration_1: Add providers in Settings using environment credentials or provider tokens, keep Observe for read-only use, and explicitly opt into allowed Propose or Act actions; Slack output reuses an existing Kiro Crew connection.
